metas.name: About Time
metas.description: At the age of 21, Tim discovers he can travel in time and change what happens and has happened in his own life. His decision to make his world a better place by getting a girlfriend turns out not to be as easy as you might think.

metas.name: Back to the Future
metas.description: Marty McFly, a 17-year-old high school student, is accidentally sent 30 years into the past in a time-traveling DeLorean invented by his close friend, the maverick scientist Doc Brown.

metas.name: The Craft
metas.description: A young girl new to a Catholic school befriends a coven of witches whom the other students either shun or fear. But when a powerful invocation goes wrong, the consequences could endanger their lives.

metas.name: Pride & Prejudice
metas.description: When Elizabeth Bennet meets the handsome Mr. Darcy, she believes he is the last man she could ever marry, but as their lives become intertwined, she finds herself captivated by the man she has sworn to hate forever.

metas.name: Hocus Pocus 2
metas.description: Two young women accidentally bring back the Sanderson Sisters to modern day Salem and must figure out how to stop the child-hungry witches from wreaking havoc on the world.

metas.name: Final Destination
metas.description: After getting a premonition about a plane crash on his school trip, Alex, a student, saves a few of his classmates. However, their situation gets complicated when death starts chasing them.

metas.name: Evil Dead
metas.description: Five friends head to a remote cabin, where the discovery of a Book of the Dead leads them to unwittingly summon up demons living in the nearby woods.

metas.name: X-Men
metas.description: In a world where mutants (evolved super-powered humans) exist and are discriminated against, two groups form for an inevitable clash: the supremacist Brotherhood, and the pacifist X-Men.

metas.name: Barbie
metas.description: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the outside world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among regular humans.

metas.name: Dracula
metas.description: Centuries-old vampire Count Dracula comes to England to seduce his barrister Jonathan Harker's fiancée Mina Murray and wreak havoc in the foreign land.

metas.name: Over Your Dead Body
metas.description: A dysfunctional married couple retreats to a secluded cabin to repair their relationship, but each secretly plots to murder the other.

metas.name: The Hunt
metas.description: A teacher lives a lonely life, all the while struggling over his son's custody. His life slowly gets better as he finds love and receives good news from his son, but his new luck is about to be brutally shattered by an innocent li...

metas.name: Titanic
metas.description: A young aristocrat falls in love with a poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated RMS Titanic.

metas.name: The Rivals of Amziah King
metas.description: Amziah King, beekeeper, musician, and anchor of his community, reunites with former foster daughter Kateri after many years apart, and fends off threats to his honey business.

metas.name: Monster House
metas.description: Three teens discover that their neighbor's house is really a living, breathing, scary monster.

metas.name: Alien
metas.description: After investigating a mysterious transmission of unknown origin, the crew of a commercial spacecraft encounters a deadly lifeform.

metas.name: Dark Shadows
metas.description: An imprisoned vampire, Barnabas Collins, is set free and returns to his ancestral home, where his dysfunctional descendants are in need of his protection.

metas.name: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
metas.description: When their relationship turns sour, a couple undergoes a medical procedure to have each other erased from their memories forever.

metas.name: A Few Good Men
metas.description: A military lawyer intends to prove that two US Marines charged with murdering a fellow Marine were only following their base commander's orders.

metas.name: Psycho
metas.description: A secretary on the run for embezzlement takes refuge at a secluded California motel owned by a repressed man and his overbearing mother.

metas.name: Django Unchained
metas.description: With the help of a German bounty-hunter, a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal plantation owner in Mississippi.

metas.name: The Lost Boys
metas.description: When a recently divorced mother and her two teenage boys move to a coastal town to stay with her father, it doesn't take long for the brothers to realize the area is a haven for something much more sinister than party-going surfers.

metas.name: The Ring
metas.description: A journalist must investigate a mysterious videotape which seems to cause the death of anyone one week to the day after they view it.

metas.name: Donnie Darko
metas.description: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a large rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.

metas.name: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
metas.description: Forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, the Fantastic Four must defend Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic herald, the Silver Surfer.

metas.name: Trick 'r Treat
metas.description: Five Halloween stories: A principal has a secret life, a virgin is looking for her first time, a group of kids pull a prank, a woman who loathes Halloween does not respect the rules and a mean old man meets a demonic trick-or-trea...

metas.name: Longlegs
metas.description: In pursuit of a serial killer, an FBI agent uncovers a series of occult clues that she must solve to end his terrifying killing spree.

metas.name: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
metas.description: A cyborg from the future, identical to the one who failed to kill Sarah Connor, must now protect her ten-year-old son John from an even more advanced and powerful cyborg.

metas.name: Apocalypse Now
metas.description: A U.S. Army officer serving in Vietnam is tasked with assassinating a renegade Special Forces Colonel who sees himself as a god.

metas.name: Dead Poets Society
metas.description: A maverick teacher at a prestigious New England boys' boarding school uses poetry to embolden his pupils to new heights of self-expression.

metas.name: Requiem for a Dream
metas.description: Four Coney Island dreamers chase love, fame, and escape, but addiction and obsession begin to distort their hopes for a better life.

metas.name: Deadpool & Wolverine
metas.description: Deadpool is offered a place in the Marvel Cinematic Universe by the Time Variance Authority, but instead recruits a variant of Wolverine to save his universe from extinction.

metas.name: Split
metas.description: Three girls are kidnapped by a man with a diagnosed 23 distinct personalities. They must try to escape before the apparent emergence of a frightful new 24th.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Far from Home
metas.description: Peter Parker heads to Europe hoping for a normal summer, but elemental attacks and a mysterious new hero pull him back into a dangerous fight he isn't ready to embrace.

metas.name: The Amateur
metas.description: When his supervisors at the CIA refuse to take action after his wife is killed in a London terrorist attack, a decoder takes matters into his own hands.

metas.name: The Bourne Identity
metas.description: A man is picked up by a fishing boat, bullet-riddled and suffering from amnesia, before racing to elude assassins and attempting to regain his memory.

metas.name: Cold Storage
metas.description: When a highly dangerous fungus escapes from a secret laboratory, a former bioterrorism agent is called back into action. Alongside two young employees, he must confront an invisible and out-of-control threat.

metas.name: The Beekeeper
metas.description: A former operative of a powerful organization embarks on a brutal campaign for vengeance.

metas.name: Spider-Man
metas.description: A shy teenager is bitten by a genetically modified spider and uses his new spider-like abilities to fight injustice as a masked superhero.

metas.name: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
metas.description: After a family tragedy, three generations of the Deetz family return home to Winter River. Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life is turned upside down when her teenage daughter, Astrid, accidentally opens the portal to the Af...

metas.name: Kingdom of Heaven
metas.description: Balian of Ibelin travels to Jerusalem during the Crusades of the 12th century, and there he finds himself as the defender of the city and its people.

metas.name: Shelter
metas.description: A reclusive former government assassin finds his forced isolation shattered when a stranded supply girl triggers a lethal tracking system, forcing him to defend her against his old handler's relentless execution squads.

metas.name: The Dark Knight Rises
metas.description: Bane, an imposing terrorist, attacks Gotham City and disrupts its eight-year-long period of peace. This forces Bruce Wayne to come out of hiding and don the cape and cowl of Batman again.

metas.name: Wicked
metas.description: Elphaba, a young woman ridiculed for her green skin, and Galinda, a popular girl, become friends at Shiz University in the Land of Oz. After an encounter with the Wonderful Wizard of Oz, their friendship reaches a crossroads.

metas.name: They Will Kill You
metas.description: A woman takes a job as a housekeeper in a NYC high-rise, unaware of the building's history of disappearances. She soon realizes the community is shrouded in mystery.

metas.name: The Faculty
metas.description: Six misfit students must band together to save mankind when mind-controlling parasites from another planet infect their high school's faculty.

metas.name: Halloween
metas.description: After being committed for 15 years, Michael Myers, now a grown man and still very dangerous, escapes from the mental institution and immediately returns to Haddonfield to find his baby sister, Laurie.

metas.name: Bones and All
metas.description: A young woman embarks on a 1000 mile odyssey through America where she meets a disenfranchised drifter. But all roads lead back to their terrifying pasts and to a final stand that will determine whether love can survive their othe...

metas.name: Emma.
metas.description: In 1800s England, a well-meaning but selfish young woman meddles in her friends' love lives.

metas.name: American Beauty
metas.description: A sexually frustrated suburban father has a mid-life crisis after becoming infatuated with his daughter's best friend.

metas.name: Pearl
metas.description: In 1918, a young woman on the brink of madness pursues stardom in a desperate attempt to escape the drudgery, isolation, and lovelessness of life on her parents' farm.

metas.name: The Truman Show
metas.description: An insurance salesman begins to suspect that his whole life is actually some sort of reality TV show.

metas.name: The Wailing
metas.description: Soon after a stranger arrives in a little village, a mysterious sickness starts spreading. A policeman, drawn into the incident, is forced to solve the mystery in order to save his daughter...

metas.name: The Notebook
metas.description: An elderly man reads to a woman with dementia the story of two young lovers whose romance is threatened by the difference in their respective social classes.

metas.name: Catch Me If You Can
metas.description: A runaway teenager lives an exciting life by forging checks and impersonating several professions, but his fraudulent activities soon attract the attention of the FBI.

metas.name: Magnolia
metas.description: An epic mosaic of interrelated characters search for love, forgiveness and meaning in the San Fernando Valley.

metas.name: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
metas.description: When strange seeds drift to earth from space, mysterious pods begin to grow and invade San Francisco, replicating the city's residents one body at a time.

metas.name: Ocean's Eleven
metas.description: A thief and his team of associates plan a sophisticated heist to rob three Las Vegas casinos at the same time.

metas.name: Casino Royale
metas.description: After earning a licence to kill, secret agent James Bond sets out on his first mission as 007. Bond must defeat a private banker funding terrorists in a high-stakes game of poker at Casino Royale, in Montenegro.

metas.name: The Terminator
metas.description: A cyborg assassin from the future attempts to find and kill a young woman who is destined to give birth to a warrior that will lead a resistance to save humankind from extinction.

metas.name: Die My Love
metas.description: A writer and young mother is suffering post-partum depression and slowly spiralling into madness. Moving into an old house with her husband, she grows more and more agitated and erratic as her mind begins to unravel.

metas.name: Tenet
metas.description: Armed with only the word "Tenet," and fighting for the survival of the entire world, CIA operative, The Protagonist, journeys through a twilight world of international espionage on a global mission that unfolds beyond real time.

metas.name: Cruel Intentions
metas.description: Two vicious step-siblings of an elite Manhattan prep school make a wager: to deflower the new headmaster's daughter before the start of term.

metas.name: The Voyeurs
metas.description: Pippa and Thomas move into their dream apartment, but notice that their windows look directly into the apartment opposite. This will set in motion a chain of events that will lead to disaster.

metas.name: Lucky
metas.description: Lucky follows the spiritual journey of a 90-year-old atheist and the quirky characters that inhabit his off the map desert town.

metas.name: Godzilla Minus One
metas.description: A kamikaze pilot plagued by survivor's guilt seeks redemption when a giant monster he failed to kill is transformed by radiation from atomic bomb tests and lays siege to post-war Japan.

metas.name: Wrath of Man
metas.description: A mysteriously stoic character is hired as a security guard by a cash truck company responsible for transporting a lot of money around Los Angeles each week.

metas.name: Léon: The Professional
metas.description: When her family is murdered by a group of corrupt officers led by the tyrannical Norman Stansfield, a young 12-year-old girl enlists the help of an Italian-American hitman to seek revenge.

metas.name: The Pianist
metas.description: During WWII, acclaimed Polish musician Wladyslaw faces various struggles as he loses contact with his family. As the situation worsens, he hides in the ruins of Warsaw in order to survive.

metas.name: White Chicks
metas.description: Two disgraced FBI agents go way undercover in an effort to protect hotel heiresses the Wilson sisters from a kidnapping plot.

metas.name: ParaNorman
metas.description: A misunderstood boy takes on ghosts, zombies and grown-ups to save his town from a centuries-old curse.

metas.name: Arrival
metas.description: Linguist Louise Banks leads a team of investigators when gigantic spaceships touch down around the world. As nations teeter on the verge of global war, Banks and her crew must find a way to communicate with the extraterrestrial vi...

metas.name: Batman Begins
metas.description: After witnessing his parents' death, billionaire Bruce Wayne learns the art of fighting to confront injustice. When he returns to Gotham as Batman, he must stop a secret society that intends to destroy the city.

metas.name: Saving Private Ryan
metas.description: Following the Normandy Landings, a group of U.S. soldiers go behind enemy lines to retrieve a paratrooper whose brothers have been killed in action.

metas.name: The Little Things
metas.description: A deputy sheriff and a sergeant search for a serial killer who's terrorizing Los Angeles.

metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: Cady Heron is a hit with The Plastics, the A-list girl clique at her new school, until she makes the mistake of falling for Aaron Samuels, the ex-boyfriend of alpha Plastic Regina George.

metas.name: Primal Fear
metas.description: A high-profile murder intrigues a publicity hungry lawyer.

metas.name: Rocky
metas.description: A small-time Philadelphia boxer gets a supremely rare chance to fight the world heavyweight champion in a bout in which he strives to go the distance for his self-respect.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: When renowned crime novelist Harlan Thrombey is found dead at his estate just after his 85th birthday, the inquisitive and debonair Detective Benoit Blanc is mysteriously enlisted to investigate.

metas.name: Snatch
metas.description: Unscrupulous boxing promoters, violent bookmakers, a Russian gangster, incompetent amateur robbers and supposedly Jewish jewelers fight to track down a priceless stolen diamond.

metas.name: The Butterfly Effect
metas.description: A boy suffers blackouts during traumatic events, but in college he finds a way to travel back in time to those moments and alter the course of his life.

metas.name: Green Book
metas.description: A working-class Italian-American bouncer becomes the driver for an African-American classical pianist on a tour of venues through the 1960s American South.

metas.name: Pearl Harbor
metas.description: Two lifelong friends and a beautiful nurse are caught up in the horror of an infamous Sunday morning in 1941.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: A group of intergalactic criminals must pull together to stop a fanatical warrior with plans to purge the universe.

metas.name: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
metas.description: Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark become targets of the Capitol after their victory in the 74th Hunger Games sparks a rebellion in the Districts of Panem.

metas.name: Smile 2
metas.description: About to embark on a world tour, global pop sensation Skye Riley begins experiencing increasingly terrifying and inexplicable events. Overwhelmed by the escalating horrors and the pressures of fame, Skye is forced to face her past.

metas.name: Hush
metas.description: A deaf mute European-American writer in her 20's who retreated to the woods to live in solitude must fight for her life in silence when a masked serial killer appears at her window.

metas.name: Life Is Beautiful
metas.description: When an open-minded Jewish waiter and his son become victims of the Holocaust, he uses a perfect mixture of will, humor and imagination to protect his son from the dangers around their camp.

metas.name: Lights Out
metas.description: A supernatural entity reemerges to terrorize a family when the lights go out at night.

metas.name: There Will Be Blood
metas.description: A story of family, religion, hatred, oil and madness, focusing on a turn-of-the-century prospector in the early days of the business.

metas.name: The Evil Dead
metas.description: Five friends travel to a cabin in the woods, where they unknowingly release flesh-possessing demons.

metas.name: Mystic River
metas.description: The tragic murder of a 19-year-old girl reunites three childhood friends still living in Boston--the victim's gangster father, a detective, and the disturbed man they both suspect of killing her.

metas.name: Everything Everywhere All at Once
metas.description: A middle-aged Chinese immigrant is swept up into an insane adventure in which she alone can save existence by exploring other universes and connecting with the lives she could have led.

metas.name: The Avengers
metas.description: Earth's mightiest heroes must come together and learn to fight as a team if they are going to stop the mischievous Loki and his alien army from enslaving humanity.

metas.name: Hacksaw Ridge
metas.description: World War II American Army Medic Desmond T. Doss, serving during the Battle of Okinawa, refuses to kill people and becomes the first man in American history to receive the Medal of Honor without firing a shot.

metas.name: Troy
metas.description: An adaptation of Homer's great epic, the film follows the assault on Troy by the united Greek forces.

metas.name: Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair
metas.description: A female assassin seeks revenge on her former lover and squad members, all of whom left her for dead.

metas.name: Iron Man
metas.description: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.

metas.name: The Goonies
metas.description: A group of young misfits called The Goonies discover an ancient map and set out on an adventure to find a legendary pirate's long-lost treasure.

metas.name: Minions & Monsters
metas.description: Follows the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they search for frightening creatures for their monster movie, partner with a green creature, and must save the planet after unleashing monsters.
